findings.current: *Three *jang* straight ahead. Three *chun* to the left.*
findings.defect: The source says three chi, not three chun; the nested italics also break the thought’s Markdown.
findings.rationale: 치 is the unit used for the leftward offset. 촌 would be chun.
findings.replacement: *Three jang straight ahead. Three chi to the left.*

findings.current: He flung his sword with all his strength.
findings.defect: “Flung his sword” suggests he threw it, though he retains it for the horizontal slash that follows.
findings.rationale: The source describes wielding the sword, not releasing it.
findings.replacement: He whipped his sword through the air with all his strength.
findings.source: 혈검마군이 온 힘을 다해 검을 흩뿌렸다.

findings.current: He didn’t get the chance, not until someone moved with a desperate resolve equal to, or perhaps even greater than, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s moments earlier.
findings.defect: “Not until” implies he got the chance after the other person moved. That movement instead stops his attempted slash.
findings.rationale: He only tries to bring the sword down; the other person acts first.
findings.replacement: But before he could, someone moved with a desperate resolve equal to—or perhaps greater than—his own moments earlier.
findings.source:
아니, 정확히는 내리그으려 했다.

어쩌면 조금 전의 혈검마군만큼, 혹은 그 이상이라 할 수 있는 필사적인 의지를 품은 누군가가 움직이기 전까지는.

findings.current: It did so with astonishing ease, as if mocking the desperate Will behind the blow.
findings.defect: Capitalized “Will” invokes the established System attribute, but 염원 here means a desperate hope or wish.
findings.rationale: The source describes the hope carried in Taekyung’s spear strike, not the System attribute 의지.
findings.replacement: It did so with astonishing ease, as if mocking the desperate hope behind the blow.
findings.source: 마치 창날에 실려 있던 필사적인 염원을 비웃기라도 하듯, 놀라울 정도로 손쉽게.

findings.current: Under ordinary circumstances—or if he were a human made of flesh and blood—his injuries would have killed him several times over.
findings.defect: “Under ordinary circumstances” loses the contrast with the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s former self, before his body was strengthened.
findings.rationale: 본래의 그 refers to what he himself used to be; the following sentence credits his extremely strengthened body with keeping him alive.
findings.replacement: If he were his former self—or even just an ordinary flesh-and-blood human—those injuries would have killed him several times over.
findings.source: 본래의 그였다면. 아니, 최소한 피륙으로 이루어진 인간이라면 이미 몇 번이나 죽어도 이상하지 않을 정도의 부상.

summary: Five actionable fidelity findings: a wrong unit, a misleading sword action, a reversed timing cue, a misapplied System term, and a lost reference to the Demon Lord’s former self.
